method: Set the soft following-error dwell strictly between one and two 30 Hz feedback intervals. Verify recovery after one isolated over-threshold frame and stopping on the third frame for a sustained error that remains below the hard threshold.

derivation.reason_for_not_using_exactly_2_over_fps: At the exact floating-point boundary, two accumulated tick increments can compare microscopically below 2/FPS and postpone detection to the fourth feedback frame.
derivation.control_semantics: One isolated soft-threshold violation may recover; a sustained violation starts timing on frame 1 and stops on frame 3 after approximately 0.0667 s. Hard-threshold violations remain immediate.

normal_physical_evidence.source_family: deduplicated passed CAL-058 and CAL-059 samples documented by CAL-064

discrete_behavior_verification.isolated_over_soft_frame_then_recovery: PASS; violation timer cleared without stop
discrete_behavior_verification.hard_over_threshold_first_frame: PASS; immediate stop with no dwell wait

regression_tests: test_motion跟踪误差持续时间位于一至两个控制周期之间
test_普通跟踪误差孤立尖峰恢复而持续两周期停止
test_硬跟踪误差首帧立即停止不等dwell

limitations: The real-arm profile remains draft and therefore is intentionally rejected by the production real-mode loader until all required parameters and evidence are complete.
No physical jam, manual obstruction, collision, or end-to-end mechanical stop-latency test was performed.
This confirms the discrete software timing semantics for the current demo, not complete mechanical jam safety certification.
